facts.content: Patient reports a 'blinding' headache for 3 days, making it difficult to focus and work.
facts.source_text: CC: “Blinding” HA x3 days; difficult to focus/work

facts.content: Headache onset was sudden upon waking and is constant.
facts.source_text: Onset: sudden, on waking; constant

facts.content: Headache is holocephalic, greater over right eye.
facts.source_text: Location: holocephalic > over R eye

facts.content: Associated symptoms include photophobia, 'shooting lights' or weird vision, mild nausea without emesis.
facts.source_text: Assoc sx: photophobia; “shooting lights”/weird vision; mild nausea (no emesis)

facts.content: Severity of headache is approximately 8/10, reducing to 5/10 with ibuprofen, providing only partial relief.
facts.source_text: Severity: ~8/10 → ~5/10 w/ ibuprofen; partial relief only

facts.content: Patient sleeps well, does not wake at night but wakes with a headache.
facts.source_text: Sleep: sleeps well; not waking at night; wakes w/ HA

facts.content: Headache worsens with sudden standing or head movement.
facts.source_text: Triggers: worse w/ sudden standing or head movement

facts.content: Negative symptoms include no tingling, numbness, weakness, smell or taste change, fever, upper respiratory, sinus, or ear symptoms, cough, phlegm, or nosebleeds.
facts.source_text: Negatives: no tingling/numbness/weakness; no smell/taste change; no fever (not checked); no URTI/sinus/ear sx; no cough/phlegm; no epistaxis/hemoptysis

facts.content: Prior headaches were intermittent pressure between the eyes lasting less than 2 days, responsive to ibuprofen without prior aura, nausea, or vomiting.
facts.source_text: Prior HA: intermittent pressure between eyes, <2 days, ibuprofen-responsive; no prior aura/N/V

facts.content: Recent eye examination showed no change in vision.
facts.source_text: Eye exam recently: no change in vision

facts.content: No past medical history reported.
facts.source_text: PMH: none reported

facts.content: Patient is on an oral contraceptive pill started approximately one year ago and takes ibuprofen as needed.
facts.source_text: Meds: oral contraceptive pill (unspecified) started ~1 yr ago; ibuprofen PRN

facts.content: No known drug allergies.
facts.source_text: Allergies: NKDA

facts.content: Mother has migraines with vomiting.
facts.source_text: FH: mother w/ migraines (with vomiting)

facts.content: Patient lives alone and works from home.
facts.source_text: SH: lives alone; WFH

facts.content: Patient has reduced productivity and missed work over 3 days due to headaches.
facts.source_text: SH: reduced productivity/missed work over 3 days

facts.content: Patient does not smoke and drinks alcohol approximately 3 units once weekly.
facts.source_text: SH: smoking: none; etOH: ~3 once weekly

facts.content: No recent travel reported.
facts.source_text: Travel: no recent

facts.content: Acute severe headache for 3 days with photophobia and visual phenomena, suspected migraine with possible aura. No focal neurological or infectious features.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute severe HA x3 days with photophobia and visual phenomena; no focal neuro or infectious features. Suspect migraine (possible aura).

facts.content: Oral contraceptive pill use may require change if migraine with aura is confirmed; blood pressure needs to be appropriate.
facts.source_text: 2) OCP use—may need contraception change if migraine w/ aura confirmed; ensure BP appropriate.

facts.content: Work impairment due to headaches.
facts.source_text: 3) Work impairment due to HA.

facts.content: Book in-person appointment for full neurological exam including fundoscopy and blood pressure check.
facts.source_text: Book in-person appt (support team) for full neuro exam incl. fundoscopy and BP

facts.content: Prescribed a stronger NSAID and advised paracetamol concurrently, to be taken with food.
facts.source_text: Rx: stronger NSAID prescribed in place of ibuprofen; may take paracetamol concurrently; take w/ food

facts.content: Continue current oral contraceptive pill for now; if migraine with aura confirmed, discuss switching contraception.
facts.source_text: Continue current OCP for now; if migraine w/ aura confirmed, discuss switching contraception

facts.content: Safety-net advice given: if headache worsens or new neurological symptoms occur, attend A&E or call for further advice.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: if HA worsens/becomes unbearable/changes or new neuro sx → attend A&E; may call for further advice

facts.content: If symptoms settle before appointment, may cancel appointment.
facts.source_text: If symptoms settle before appt, may cancel appointment
